# Overwatch Patch Notes – March 8, 2017

> 日期: 2017-03-08 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2017/03

March 8, 2017 Overwatch Patch Notes – March 8, 2017 A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn about the latest changes. To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum. For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum. GENERAL Custom Games Players can no longer gain EXP from skirmishes in custom games AFK detection has been added to skirmishes in custom games Top of post
